sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.text_preview: T HE wide use of portable communication systems has created a great demand for low-cost, low-power, small formfactor transceivers. In the past, radio frequency (RF) front-end circuits have been implemented with GaAs or bipolar junction transistor (BJT) technologies while the low-frequency baseband circuits have used CMOS technologies.
